name: Review Backend Changes
description: Reviews Java backend files for Spring Boot best practices including logging, validation, and exception handling when created or edited

then.prompt: Review the new Java file against our backend standards: (1) Controllers handle HTTP concerns only — no business logic. (2) Services contain business logic, use constructor injection. (3) Entities and DTOs use jakarta.validation annotations (@NotBlank, @Size, @Min, @Max, @Pattern). (4) Proper HTTP status codes (201 Created for POST, 204 No Content for DELETE, 404 for missing resources). (5) Errors should be handled via GlobalExceptionHandler, not try-catch in controllers. (6) Logging: use SLF4J Logger with parameterized messages ({}), appropriate levels (DEBUG for reads, INFO for mutations, WARN for client errors, ERROR for unexpected failures). Never log passwords, tokens, or secrets. (7) All @RequestBody parameters must have @Valid annotation. (8) JavaDoc on public methods. Suggest improvements if needed.
